Circle of latitude.question: The latitude of the polar circles is equal to 90° minus the _____'s axial tilt
Circle of latitude.fact: Of the parallels or circles of latitude, it is the longest, and the only 'great circle' (a circle on the surface of the Earth, centered on Earth's center). All the other parallels are smaller and centered only on Earth's axis.

Circle of latitude.subject: Meteorology & Climate
Circle of latitude.question: Rather, all points sharing the same latitude—but of varying elevation and longitude—occupy the surface of a truncated cone formed by the rotation of this normal around the _____'s axis of rotation
Circle of latitude.fact: Since (in the geodetic system) altitude and depth are determined by the normal to the Earth's surface, locations sharing the same latitude—but having different elevations (i.e., lying along this normal)—no longer lie within this plane.
